lines.t: (Verse 1)
There’s a quiet spot across my kitchen table
And another quiet evening passing by
I know every line of your face, every story
I love you so much more now that the Lord opened my eyes
You’re out there chasing the high of an empty world
Running till your feet are bare and sore
While I’m sitting here, watching my life unfold
Wishing you were walking through my door
(Pre-Chorus)
I’m holding the phone, wanting so bad to call
To tell you the good news, to share it all
It hurts so bad to keep this line in the sand
When all I want is to reach for your hand
(Chorus)
Tears are streaming down my face tonight
Half of them are joy for this holy light
And half of them are burning with the pain of losing you
You’re missing every milestone, every precious thing
Missing out on all the peace the Lord can bring
I watch you walk away from what is real and true
I’m standing in His grace, and I wish you were here
(Verse 2)
You miss the way my spirit has finally settled
The way my home feels warm and free from strife
You think I turned my back because I chose Him
But I’m just trying to guard this renewed life
It breaks me in two to watch you miss the show
Trading eternal glory for a temporary glow
I love you deeper now than I ever did before
And that’s why it hurts to close the door
(Pre-Chorus)
I’m holding the phone, wanting so bad to call
To tell you the good news, to share it all
It hurts so bad to keep this line in the sand
When all I want is to reach for your hand
(Chorus)
Tears are streaming down my face tonight
Half of them are joy for this holy light
And half of them are burning with the pain of losing you
You’re missing every milestone, every precious thing
Missing out on all the peace the Lord can bring
I watch you walk away from what is real and true
I’m standing in His grace, and I wish you were here
(Bridge)
I pray until my heart is bruised and weak
That you would taste the goodness that I speak
I pray you stop running from the Father's face
And come sit beside me in this holy place
I miss you every morning, every single night...
Come out of the dark and step into the light!
(Guitar Solo)
(Chorus)
Tears are streaming down my face tonight
Half of them are joy for this holy light
And half of them are burning with the pain of losing you
You’re missing every milestone, every precious thing
Missing out on all the peace the Lord can bring
I watch you walk away from what is real and true
I’m standing in His grace, and I wish you were here
(Outro)
I miss you so much...
I’m standing in His grace...
I wish you were here.
Yeah, I wish you were here.
